wish: someone should make a music player that organizes songs by BPM
spec:
Detects the tempo of audio files you add from your device and lists them sorted by BPM.
Tap Add songs, set a From/To BPM range, flip slow-to-fast, tap a song to play; playback continues down the list. Test beats are listed first so the list works before any file is added.
It does not upload anything, read tags, or find beat grids; tempo is estimated from a 90 s excerpt, and the divide by 2 and times 2 buttons fix half or double readings.
notes: Fully offline. Playback uses Web Audio because the CSP allows no blob: media. A song is decoded again when played.
